sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1998
ORDINANCE XVII OF
1998
PAKISTAN ARMED FORCES (ACTING IN AID OF THE CIVIL POWER) (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
An Ordinance to amend the
Pakistan Armed Forces (Acting in Aid of the Civil Power) Ordinance, 1998
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 22nd December, 1998]
No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
22-12-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Armed Forces (Acting in Aid of the Civil Power) (Second Amendment)
Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 22nd December, 1998]
No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
22-12-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 4, Ordinance XII of 1998.--In the Pakistan
Armed Forces (Acting in Aid of the Civil Power) Ordinance, 1998 (XII of 1998),
in section 4, in subsection (1) for the word 'three' the word 'eight' shall be
substituted.
